mapper.select: SELECT album_id AS albumId, user_id AS userId, title, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, album_image_URL AS albumImageUrl, view_cnt AS viewCnt, status FROM album ORDER BY album_id DESC

SELECT album_id AS albumId, user_id AS userId, title, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, album_image_URL AS albumImageUrl, view_cnt AS viewCnt, status FROM album WHERE album_id = #{albumId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO album ( user_id, title, album_image_URL, view_cnt, status ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, #{albumImageUrl}, #{viewCnt}, #{status} )
mapper.update: UPDATE album SET user_id = #{userId}, title = #{title}, album_image_URL = #{albumImageUrl}, view_cnt = #{viewCnt}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE album_id = #{albumId}
